Pod 9 (Priority Seating for Accessibility) (Group Rooms) Capacity: 1

Description

  • This study pod is prioritized for individuals with accessibility or assistive device related needs.
  • It is not a group pod and is intended for a single user.
  • This pod is available for drop-in when not in use, but you may be asked to leave if a priority user needs it (regardless of booking status).
